name: browser
description: Persistent native browser automation (Playwright, in-process - no subprocess). ONE browser stays alive between calls, so cookies, logins and tabs survive. Use for: opening/scraping pages, clicking and typing through multi-step web flows, capturing network and console logs, running JS in the page, and taking screenshots to actually SEE what a page rendered. NOT for the desktop GUI - use computer_use for that.

action.description: Operation. RECOMMENDED LOOP: action=snapshot to get @eN refs, then pass those refs as `selector` (e.g. '@e3') to click/type/extract. Re-snapshot after any page change. BLOCKED BY A SITE? If you hit 'this browser or app may not be secure', a bot wall, or a login that refuses to proceed, call action=close then reopen the SAME url with headless=false - headed Chromium gets past most of these. ALWAYS call action=close when the task is done. It kills the browser.

url.description: For open/tab_new. http(s)://, file://, or a local path (auto-converted to file://). Bare domains get https:// prepended.

selector.description: Element target for click/type/hover/select/extract/dump_html/screenshot/wait. Accepts an @eN ref from action=snapshot (preferred) or a normal CSS selector. Unknown refs fail instantly with the list of valid ones.

key.description: Key or combo for action=press, e.g. 'Enter', 'ctrl+a'.

js.description: JavaScript for action=eval. Prefix 'b64:' for base64 or 'file:' for a path.

filename.description: Output filename for screenshot. '.png' appended if missing. Defaults to a timestamped name.

full_page.description: Screenshot the whole scrollable page, not just the viewport.

screenshot.description: For open/click: also capture a screenshot after the action finishes.

wait_until.description: Navigation event to wait for on open. Default domcontentloaded.

url_pattern.description: For action=wait: wait until the page URL matches this pattern.

state.description: For action=wait with a selector. Default visible.

seconds.description: For action=wait with no selector/url_pattern: sleep this long (max 120).

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for click/wait in milliseconds. Default 10000 (click) / 30000 (wait).

max_chars.description: Truncate dump_html/extract/source output to this many chars. Default 20000.

level.description: For console_log: filter by level (log, warning, error, info, debug).

cookies.description: For set_cookies: JSON array of Playwright cookie objects.

browser.description: Engine to launch. Default chromium. user_data_dir only applies to chromium.

executable_path.description: Absolute path to a browser binary to use instead of Playwright's bundled build. e.g. /usr/bin/google-chrome-stable

browser_binary.description: Shortcut for the binary: 'chrome', 'chromium', 'edge', 'brave', or any executable name on PATH. Resolved to a path automatically.

user_data_dir.description: Chrome profile directory for a persistent context (keeps logins). Defaults to ~/sable_output/browser/profile. Chromium only.

headless.description: Run without a visible window. Default true. Set FALSE when a site blocks automation (Google, Cloudflare, most login walls) - headed mode usually clears those checks. Requires a display (DISPLAY or WAYLAND_DISPLAY). This is a LAUNCH param: it only applies on the call that starts the browser, so action=close first if the browser is already running.

args.description: Extra Chromium launch flags as a JSON array or comma-separated string, e.g. '["--proxy-server=http://127.0.0.1:8080"]'.

width.description: Viewport width shortcut (used when viewport is absent).

interactive_only.description: For snapshot: only interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs). Default true. Set false to include headings, images and landmarks.

scope.description: For snapshot: limit to a CSS selector subtree, e.g. '#main' or 'form'.

max_depth.description: For snapshot: cap tree depth. Default 12.

annotate.description: For action=screenshot ONLY: temporarily overlay numbered labels matching the @eN refs, capture, then remove them. Use when text alone is not enough (icon-only buttons, canvas, 3D scenes). For persistent labels you can see in a headed browser, use action=annotate instead.

by.description: For find: how to locate the element. role|text|label|placeholder|testid|alt|title.

do.description: For find: what to do with the match. Default count.

name.description: For find: accessible name filter (e.g. do=click, by=role, value=button, name='Submit'). Also the attribute name for do=attr.

exact.description: For find: require an exact match on text/role name.

nth.description: For find: pick the Nth match (0-based).

files.description: For upload: JSON array or comma-separated absolute file paths.

what.description: For set: which browser setting to change.

headers.description: For set what=headers: JSON object of extra HTTP headers.

route_action.description: For route: abort blocks the request, mock serves 'body', continue passes through.

status.description: For route mock: HTTP status. Default 200.

content_type.description: For route mock: response content type. Default application/json.

har_path.description: For har_replay: path to a recorded .har file to serve requests from.

not_found.description: For har_replay: what to do when a request is missing from the HAR. Default abort.
